text: どれ　みせてみい　………なんや　これなら　なんとか　なりそうやないか！

structure.jp: なんとか　なりそうやないか！
structure.en: it looks like it can be sorted out, doesn't it!

patterns.name: 〜てみる
patterns.explanation: てみる after a verb means 'try doing'. みい is the Kansai dialect way of telling someone to do it, like みろ. みせてみい = 'go on, show me'.

patterns.name: 〜そうだ
patterns.explanation: そう added to a verb with its ます cut off means 'looks like it will'. なんとか　なりそう = 'looks like it will work out somehow'.

patterns.name: 〜ではないか
patterns.explanation: やないか is the Kansai dialect form of じゃないか, which pushes a point with 'isn't it!'. なりそうやないか = 'it looks like it will work out, doesn't it!'
